balance.equation: P - ET - generated surface runoff - lateral flow - percolation - soil and snow storage change
balance.scope: Annual area-weighted balance for this unconnected, non-irrigated HRU experiment only.

limitations: Reference HRU experiment; no calibrated real basin.
Surface runoff is generated on land, not routed river flow or available supply.
Original reference basin weights sum to 2; this view uses normalized HRU areas instead of basin totals.
Three warm-up years are excluded, but warm-up convergence has not been established.
Game construction and allocation controls are not yet coupled to SWAT+.
